_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Wɛ̈t kuoth thok kë yiic ku wɛ̈r ä {width}x{height}.
Yin ä wɛ̈t kuoth {player_id}. Ciɛ̈ŋde wɛ̈t: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kɛn w/s/a/d.
Thiäi: ku jol wɛ̈tde cɔl. Kɛ̈r thokde ku bɛ̈n; ku thok kë bɛ̈n wɛ̈r; ku thok kë cɔl wɛ̈r ku bɛ̈n.

board.current: Kuär in tä thi̱n ɛn täämɛ: {board}
board.after_moves: Kɛn gua̱th diaal tin ci̱ naath rɔ̱ mat thi̱n: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Player {player_id} cɛ li̱w kɛ ɣöö /ci̱kɛ lät.

outcome.survived_win: Player {player_id} cɛ kään; nɛy tin kɔ̱ŋ diaal cukɛ rɔ̱ yuɔr piny.
outcome.all_crashed: Nɛy diaal tëë ci̱ wɔ̱ piny cu kɛ ben gua̱a̱th kɛl.
outcome.outlived: Player cɛ tëk ni̱ kɛn diaal.
outcome.all_dead: Nɛy diaal tëë ci̱ wɔ̱ thi̱n.
outcome.turn_limit: Mi̱ ci̱ pek in ca thöp cop - ram min te tëk kɛ gua̱a̱th mi̱ bäär laa tiamɛ.
